source_text: Gain 1 Cash per Finance business you own.
short: +1 Cash per Finance business

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment from pawned tools. Whenever you sell or absorb a business, gain Cash equal to its value.
short: +1 Equipment. When you sell or absorb a business, gain Cash equal to its value

source_text: Pay 2 Cash: +2 Brand per Finance business you own. Passive: gain 1 Cash at the end of each quarter (interest).
short: Pay 2 Cash: +2 Brand per Finance business. Quarter end: +1 Cash

source_text: +2 Brand per pip on the die. If the die is a 1, Penny Stock becomes distressed.
short: +2 Brand per pip. On a 1, it becomes distressed

source_text: Gain 1 Cash. Once per quarter, the first business that would become distressed doesn't, and you gain 3 Brand.
short: +1 Cash. Once a quarter, stops a business becoming distressed: +3 Brand

source_text: Needs no die. At quarter end, +1 Brand per 2 unspent Cash (max 5).
short: No die. Quarter end: +1 Brand per 2 unspent Cash (max 5)

source_text: Interest: gain Cash equal to half the Cash you hold (max 4).
short: Interest: gain Cash equal to half your Cash (max 4)

source_text: Pay 3 Cash: acquire a random Tech business from the deal deck.
short: Pay 3 Cash: acquire a random Tech business

source_text: When bought, absorb an adjacent business: remove it and permanently add its value to this one (counts as a sale). Operate: +1 Brand per adjacent Finance business.
short: On buy: absorb an adjacent business, keeping its value. +1 Brand per adjacent Finance

source_text: Run the abilities of every adjacent Finance business that already operated this quarter again.
short: Re-runs adjacent Finance businesses that already operated

source_text: Gain 1 Labor per Services business you own.
short: +1 Labor per Services business

source_text: Gain 2 Labor. Passive: gain 1 Labor at the end of each quarter (contract staff).
short: +2 Labor. Quarter end: +1 Labor

source_text: Gain 1 Cash. At the end of each quarter it operated, it permanently gains +1 value.
short: +1 Cash. Grows +1 value each quarter it operates

source_text: Gain 1 Labor. +1 Brand per adjacent Services business.
short: +1 Labor. +1 Brand per adjacent Services business

source_text: Pay 2 Labor: +2 Brand per Services business you own.
short: Pay 2 Labor: +2 Brand per Services business

source_text: A rolling advert: gain 1 Advertising. Feeds the workers: +2 Brand per adjacent Services business that operated this quarter.
short: +1 Advertising. +2 Brand per adjacent Services business that operated

source_text: Can operate a second time this quarter with a die of the same value. +3 Brand on the second operation.
short: Can operate again with a die of the same value. +3 Brand the second time

source_text: Gain 1 Labor. Whenever an adjacent Services business operates, gain 1 Labor.
short: +1 Labor. +1 Labor whenever an adjacent Services business operates

source_text: Gain 1 Intelligence. +1 Brand per Labor your businesses have spent this quarter.
short: +1 Intelligence. +1 Brand per Labor spent by businesses this quarter

source_text: Pay 3 Labor: +2 Brand per business that has operated this quarter.
short: Pay 3 Labor: +2 Brand per business operated this quarter

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment per Industry business you own.
short: +1 Equipment per Industry business

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment. +1 Brand per adjacent Industry business.
short: +1 Equipment. +1 Brand per adjacent Industry business

source_text: Pay 1 Equipment: +1 Brand per Industry business you own. Passive: gain 1 Equipment at the end of each quarter (restocking).
short: Pay 1 Equipment: +1 Brand per Industry business. Quarter end: +1 Equipment

source_text: Turn around one distressed business. +1 Brand per 2 Equipment you hold (max 3).
short: Turn around a distressed business. +1 Brand per 2 Equipment held (max 3)

source_text: Pay 2 Equipment: choose an adjacent business. It permanently gains +1 value.
short: Pay 2 Equipment: an adjacent business gains +1 value permanently

source_text: +1 Brand per Industry business that has operated this quarter.
short: +1 Brand per Industry business operated this quarter

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment. Whenever you sell or absorb a business, gain 2 Equipment.
short: +1 Equipment. When you sell a business, gain 2 Equipment

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment per adjacent business from another sector.
short: +1 Equipment per adjacent business from another sector

source_text: Also operates (without a die) whenever the business to its left operates. +1 Brand per other Industry business in its row.
short: Runs when its left neighbour does. +1 Brand per other Industry in its row

source_text: Gain 1 Equipment and 1 Cash from selling power. Adjacent businesses can be operated with any single die.
short: +1 Equipment, +1 Cash. Adjacent businesses accept any single die

source_text: Gain 1 Intelligence per Tech business you own. Passive: gain 1 Intelligence at the end of each quarter (data feeds).
short: +1 Intelligence per Tech business. Quarter end: +1 Intelligence

source_text: Startup. Gain 1 Intelligence; +1 die next quarter.
short: Startup. +1 Intelligence, +1 die next quarter

source_text: Pay 1 Intelligence: +1 Brand per pip on the die.
short: Pay 1 Intelligence: +1 Brand per pip

source_text: Pay 2 Intelligence: +2 Brand per Tech business you own.
short: Pay 2 Intelligence: +2 Brand per Tech business

source_text: Gain 1 Advertising from customer insights. Look at the top 3 deals in the deck and swap one into deal flow.
short: +1 Advertising. Peek at 3 deals, swap one into deal flow

source_text: Gain 1 Intelligence. +1 Brand per Tech business you own.
short: +1 Intelligence. +1 Brand per Tech business

source_text: Pay 1 Intelligence: every adjacent Startup permanently gains +1 value.
short: Pay 1 Intelligence: adjacent Startups gain +1 value permanently

source_text: Startup. Needs no die. After 4 quarters it becomes a random business worth 5 or more. Each adjacent Tech business makes it mature 1 quarter faster.
short: Startup. No die. Becomes a 5+ value business. Adjacent Tech speeds it up

source_text: Startup. Copies the ability of the business to its left (paying any costs it has).
short: Startup. Copies the ability of the business to its left

source_text: +1 Brand per Intelligence you hold (max 8).
short: +1 Brand per Intelligence you hold (max 8)

source_text: Gain 1 Advertising per Consumer business you own.
short: +1 Advertising per Consumer business

source_text: Draws in shoppers: gain 1 Advertising per adjacent Consumer business.
short: +1 Advertising per adjacent Consumer business

source_text: Gain 1 Advertising. +2 Brand per other Coffee Chain you own.
short: +1 Advertising. +2 Brand per other Coffee Chain

source_text: Pay 2 Advertising: +2 Brand per Consumer business you own.
short: Pay 2 Advertising: +2 Brand per Consumer business

source_text: Pay 1 Advertising: +1 Brand per different die value used this quarter.
short: Pay 1 Advertising: +1 Brand per different die value used

source_text: Pay 2 Advertising: weaken the event in outlook slot 2 (full becomes partial).
short: Pay 2 Advertising: weaken the next event

source_text: Gain 1 Advertising. Whenever an adjacent Consumer business operates, gain 1 Advertising and 1 Brand.
short: +1 Advertising. When an adjacent Consumer business operates: +1 Advertising, +1 Brand

source_text: Needs no die. Anchor tenant: adjacent Consumer businesses are worth +1 value. Passive: gain 1 Advertising at the end of each quarter (foot traffic).
short: No die. Adjacent Consumer worth +1 value. Quarter end: +1 Advertising

source_text: Gain 2 Advertising per Consumer business you own.
short: +2 Advertising per Consumer business

source_text: Pay 2 Advertising: +2 Brand per adjacent business.
short: Pay 2 Advertising: +2 Brand per adjacent business
